title: QMA-hardness of continuum Coulomb energy with unit nuclear charges
main_claim: Approximating the electronic ground-energy infimum of the clamped-nucleus Coulomb Hamiltonian with all nuclear charges equal to 1, over the full spinful antisymmetric continuum space, is QMA-hard under deterministic poly-time reductions. The output has polynomially many nuclei and electrons and threshold separation >= 1.
coverage:
I read every section: source, spin, wells, density, nuclei, many-body and implementation.

Source and spin sections:
- Source rounding offsets (5ε0) and the resulting gap δ−12ε0.
- Singlet-mediator second-order shift −3Δ−3v²/2 and the sign selection C=B or C=A. Checked by hand via singlet Pauli correlations and numerically by exact diagonalization; the error scales as Δ^{-1/2}, as predicted.
- Perturbation lemma (Schur complement / resolvent identity).
- Planar contact layout: the 8 and 8.5 spans, transverse offset 1.3229, the separations ≥ √2 and ≥ 1.5, the perpendicular-gadget cases, and surjectivity of the length differential.

Wells section:
- The Coulomb-coercivity proof, including the constant in the Poisson/Cauchy–Schwarz inequality.
- Occupancy completion identity (C) and the penalty gap.
- Hubbard superexchange t²/(U−v_ij)(h−I) with intersite v. Checked numerically on a two-site model; it matches to O(t⁴).
- Target hopping and calibration brackets.

Density section:
- The slab potential gives 2πρz², and ω = √(4πρ).
- Identity (4) and density positivity.
- IMS/tensor gap argument.
- Residual ‖L_cP‖ ≤ λ^{-0.9}.
- Diagonal counterterm b_i and the Gram-correction scales.

Nuclei section:
- Gauss node offsets h/(2√3), degree-3 exactness, and mass ρh³/8 = 1/λ with λ = 8k³/ρ.
- Far-cube sum giving O(h²); local Hardy bound giving h²‖u‖² + h⁴‖∇u‖².
- Compressed O(h⁴) bound via |D⁴K_ij| ≲ (1+|b|)^{-5}.
- Rounding bound ρ|Ω|δ_R ≤ λ^{-8}.

Many-body and thresholds:
- Square completion α‖q‖₁² − 2β‖w‖‖q‖₁ ≥ −β²/α, the requirement E_Π ≤ α, and the error bookkeeping λ^{-4/3}·λ = λ^{-1/3}.
- Affine threshold map: the 7/100 budget fits under 1/8, the margins 1/8 < 1/4 − 1/32 hold, and b−a ≥ (7/16)λτ²γ ≥ 7/2.
- C_H precision budget and the Euler flow error.

Not checked independently: the cited CMP2019 Theorem 48 / Lemma 47 (QMA-hardness of signed square-lattice Heisenberg with polynomial weights).
sibling_notes: The rank-327 sibling (binary nuclear charges) also reported no_gap_found. This paper is self-contained and does not invoke the companion's hardness theorem, so there is no circularity. Both papers share the CMP2019 polynomial-weight source and the Piddock–Montanaro singlet mediators; the mediator constants are confirmed numerically here.
